description: Sends a request for a new template or component (what it is, the industry or style, any reference) to the AnimatedWebs team and returns a confirmation line with the request id. Use this only after search found nothing suitable; it is the only way to send feedback or ask for a missing template or component. It writes one message to the team's inbox tied to the signed-in account email; check its progress later with get_request_status, and note that repeating a call creates a duplicate. Requests are reviewed for the weekly template drops and Lifetime members are prioritized. Requires sign-in.

request.description: What you want built, 10 to 1500 characters: subject, industry, style, references. Example: 'a scroll-driven hero for a yacht charter with a night-sea video'.

name: request_template
title: Request a template
